junkville/dogs/leader.about-back-to-entry: I see. Let's talk about something else.
junkville/dogs/leader.about-dogs:
We're Diamond Dogs. That's what your kind used to call us, long before.

We're creatures of the depths. We dig the finer rocks and freshest earth to create our own haven where the sun doesn't blind.
junkville/dogs/leader.about-dogs/diamonds:
We eat the diamonds.

They're pretty. Shiny. Tasty. Some of the gems, we eat. Some have other values to us.

Way before, we traded some with ponies. But our past taught us that trust should not be given so easily.
junkville/dogs/leader.about-dogs/entry:
We're Diamond Dogs. That's what your kind used to call us, long before.

We're creatures of the depths. We dig the finer rocks and freshest earth to create our own haven where the sun doesn't blind.
junkville/dogs/leader.about-why-diamond: I still don't get the diamond part.
junkville/dogs/leader.accept-scavenger-trade: Alright. I'll come back with the supplies you need.
junkville/dogs/leader.already-healed-wounded: I already healed your wounded, actually.
junkville/dogs/leader.ask-about-spinel: Hey, you Diamond Dogs know your stuff about cristals right ? I'm looking for an electromagic spinel.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-ask-details: How many of them are down there? What are you dealing with?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-ask-reinforcements: I'll need some backup. Can you spare a few fighters to watch my back?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-ask-reward: I think we spoke of a reward. Gems, specifically.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-back-to-about: Let me think about it. Let's talk about something else.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-confirm-quest: Consider it done. I'm heading down there now.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-demand-pay: I don't risk my skin for free. What's in it for me?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-offer-help: I can handle a few raiders. I'll clear them out for you.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-refuse: Sounds dangerous. You're on your own with that one.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-report-dogs-reply: It was an honor. What's the plan moving forward?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-report-junkville-reply: They want peace as much as you do. Let's talk terms.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-report-resolution: About those raiders in your lower caverns…
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-report-solo-reply: I did it for your pack. Now, about those negotiations...
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits-suggest-collapse: [Science/Explosives] Instead of a frontal assault, what if I find structural weak points and cave the tunnels in on top of them?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/accept-quest: You would do that? A surface pony fighting other surface dwellers for the sake of the pack? If you cleanse our tunnels of that filth, you will earn the eternal gratitude of our pack.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/barter-failure: Typical pony.  We have nothing to give but our thanks. Take it or leave it.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/barter-success: Typical pony. Fine. Clear out the raiders, and I'll make sure you're rewarded with some of our finest gems. Deal?
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/collapse-plan:
The leader's eyes light up with a cruel gleam.

Clever pony. Dirty, but clever. Yes, if you find the support beams near their main camp, a few well-placed sparks or blasts would bury them alive. Just... make sure it doesn't destabilize our current den.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/details: A dozen or so. They have set up barricades, hoarding scrap, drinking rotgut, and shooting at anything with fur. They are turning our ancestral home into a pigsty.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/intro: What happened ? A bunch of ponies settled right into our lower caverns. They attacked us unprovoked, using those terrible fire-sticks. We were forced to retreat here, where they seem not to dare disturb us.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/reinforce-failure: That is not a good idea. You have not earned our trust yet, and trust is paramount between fighters. You go alone, or not at all.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/reinforce-success: Very well. I cannot spare my best guards, but I will send any volunteer your way.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/report-dogs:
The raiders are gone, and our lower tunnels are secure once more.

You fought well alongside my pack. You are a true friend to the Diamond Dogs.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/report-junkville:
My scouts tell me the surface dwellers from Junkville marched down alongside you to purge the bandits. I... I am astonished.

Perhaps... perhaps they are not all like the monsters of our past.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/report-solo:
The lower tunnels have gone quiet. I understand you took care of those raiders?

This is a magnificent feat, pony. You have secured our home, and we owe you a great debt.
junkville/dogs/leader.bandits/tell-about-location: You need to know where to find them. Simple. From here, keep to your right right until you reach the lower caverns. Then take a left and follow the tunnel. You'll meet them eventually. Best luck to you.
junkville/dogs/leader.believe-attempt: [Speech] If I wanted you dead, you'd already know it. I'm not here to hurt anyone.
junkville/dogs/leader.bring-up-negociations: About the negociations with the surface dwellers…
junkville/dogs/leader.bring-up-negociations-init: Have you considered getting into contact with the surface ponies ?
junkville/dogs/leader.captives-not-bandits: They aren't bandits. Let them go.
junkville/dogs/leader.details-intro-back: I see. Let's talk about something else.
junkville/dogs/leader.distrust-threaten: Then let's get this over with.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact-exit-go-for-quest: Here we go. What do you want ?
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/bandit-details: There's a dozen of them, maybe more, holed up behind scrap barricades. They drink, they fight each other half the time, and they shoot at anything that gets close to the lower tunnels.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/bandit-proposal: A pony joke, maybe ? Or do you really think you could succeed where my pack has failed ? I don't see that happening. But if you mean it, if you're truly willing to clear those raiders out of our home, then I won't be the one to stop you.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/bandit-suspicion: Hmph. Exploring. Right into our tunnels, at the worst possible time. Tell me, pony. Are you with the others ?
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/bandits-explained: Surfacers with fire-sticks and no manners. They forced their way into our lower caverns, attacked without warning, and left several of my pack bleeding before we could retreat here. Are you one of them ?
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/distrust: Then you will remain where I can watch you. One wrong move, and my patience runs out.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/entry: What a surprise… a pony who doesn't shoot nor run at the sight of us. You walked into our tunnels uninvited. So talk. Why did you risk your life coming down here ?
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/on-exit-attempt: No. You came down here, intruded in our home. The only way you're leaving here alive is with you doing something for us.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/on-exit-attempt-alt: I'm not done with you yet. I'm confident you'll be able to help with a pressing matter. We need you.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/why-believe-you: Convince me, then. Give me one good reason not to let my dogs tear you apart where you stand.
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/why-here: Not a very likely story. You don't belog in these caverns. So why are you here ?
junkville/dogs/leader.first-contact/why-here-reentry: Sure. Let's start by talking about why you came down here.
junkville/dogs/leader.go-to-the-pen: I quite enjoy being alive. To then pen we go.
junkville/dogs/leader.hub-ask-about-wounded-dogs: I was wondering, how did your fellow dogs get wounded ?
junkville/dogs/leader.intimidation-free-scavengers: Let the scavengers go, right now, or else.
junkville/dogs/leader.intro-not-looking-for-trouble: Easy. I'm not looking for trouble.
junkville/dogs/leader.intro-seeking-scavengers: I'm looking for some missing scavengers.
junkville/dogs/leader.intro-threaten: Get out of my way, or I'll make you.
junkville/dogs/leader.motives-followup: You really think the surface dwellers will accept ?
junkville/dogs/leader.motives-question: Ransoming hostages will not put the surface dwellers in a good mood for negociations. If you wish to reach a peaceful relationship with the surface, then you might have to show a proof of good will first.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-accept: Then let's do it. Open negotiations with Junkville.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-ask-clarifications: What would your terms even be, if you did negotiate ?
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-ask-skepticism: Why not give them a chance ? Not every pony is like the ones from your past.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-push-hiding: Perhaps it'd be better… if you remained hidden.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-push-hiding-2: The scavengers won't accept to give up the tunnels. There's a lot of resources there for them to scavenge.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-reject-sarcastically: Yeah, no. Find yourself another mailpony.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-trade-frame-caps: You'll get plenty of caps for it. Everypony likes caps.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-trade-frame-dismissive: It's just some rocks. Why does it even matter to you ?
junkville/dogs/leader.negociate-trade-frame-mutual: It's not just about caps. Trade keeps the peace between us stronger, and your pack gets medicine and tools when it needs them - not just bits jingling in a pouch.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociation-suggest-waiting: It's too soon. Give them time.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociation-why-me: You really want me to change their minds ?
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/agreed: …Fine. You've made your point, more than once. I'll allow it. As long as we can agree the underground remains ours to use. Go on, then. Tell them the diamond dogs are willing to talk.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/argue-bandits-help: Junkville marched down here and fought the bandits shoulder to shoulder with your pack. That's not nothing.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/argue-future: You can't keep the surface out forever, Fido. Better to build something on your own terms now, than have it forced on you later.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/argue-need-help: Your pack needed outside help before - remember the wounded dogs ? You didn't turn it down then.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/clarifications: The only thing we want from the surface is to leave us alone. The tunnels are ours. We've lived there for generations.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/debate-continue: Back again ? Go on, then. Convince me, if you think you still can.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/debate-entry:
Relationship ? With the surface ?

My wounded dogs got better thanks to you. I won't forget that. But one act of kindness doesn't undo generations of misdeeds. I don't see what good could come from opening our door to your kind.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/debate-leave: I'll leave you to think about it.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/entry:
Relationship ? With the surface ?

My wounded dogs got better thanks to you. I won't forget that. But one act of kindness doesn't undo generations of misdeeds. I don't see what good could come from opening our door to your kind.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/hiding: You're probably right. We prevailed for generations, secluded down in these tunnels… perhaps it's best to protect our way of life for the time being, and wait for the surface to become more peaceful.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/on-accepted: You have a silver tongue, pony - more than I'm comfortable with. Very well. Tell them we want peace, safety for our kind. The dogs do not give their trust easily, and I know our attitude will make it hard for them to trust us in return. I know it wont be easy, but if you speak in our name, maybe they'll listen.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/on-accepted-bandits: Thank you. I won't pretend I'm not still wary… but you healed what was broken in my pack, and then you and your kind bled next to my dogs against those raiders. That's not something a pony does for show. If Junkville is willing to stand with us when it matters, maybe it's time we stood with them too. Tell them we want peace, and safety for our kind.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/on-junkville-accept: That is an excellent news ! I'm glad that everyone's ready to work together ! We will send a delegation soon. Thank you for your help. The diamond dogs will remember.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/on-junkville-reject:
I see… I was afraid things would go down that path. I hope we can live side by side, without any further incidents… I guess we'll see.
Thank you for trying. You're not like the other surface dwellers. You're trustworthy. And I'll remember it.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/point-bandits-made: No. It's not. I still don't fully understand why they'd bleed for dogs they'd never met… but they did. That counts for something, I'll grant you that.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/point-future-made: …You're not wrong. Sooner or later, the surface finds its way down here, one way or another. Better it be a hand extended than a blade.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/point-help-made: We did. And I'm not made of stone - I remember who came when we needed it. But needing help once doesn't mean opening our home to strangers forever.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/pushed-to-hide: Maybe you're right. We've survived down here for generations without needing your kind. Why risk everything now, on the hope of a peace that might not hold ?
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/skepticism: A chance ? Every chance we ever gave your kind ended in chains, in whips, in cages. I won't gamble my pack's future on the hope that this time might be different.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/trade-accepted: Fair is fair. My pack has more gems than we know what to do with, and precious little of what we actually need. If Junkville is willing to trade honestly - caps and gems aside - then bring them down. We'll talk terms.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/trade-accepted-recap: We already agreed on the gems, pony. Bring Junkville's terms whenever they're ready.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/trade-entry: There's another matter. Junkville wants access to what's under our claws - the gems, the finer stone. Trade, they call it.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/trade-locked: Rocks ? Is that all you surface dwellers see when you look at our home ? No. I won't hand over what's ours so you can weigh it in caps. This conversation is over.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/trade-locked-recap: I said what I said. The gems stay ours. Don't bring it up again.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/waiting-on-randy: I've made my choice. Now we wait and see if the surface dwellers are as ready as I am.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/wary-refusal: Trust, so easily given? After bandits crawled into our home and we had to fight tooth and claw just to keep it? You brought medicine when we needed it, and I won't forget that - but gratitude isn't trust. Heal what's still broken in my pack, stand with us against whatever else comes for our tunnels, and maybe then I'll believe your surface dwellers mean us no harm. Until then, pretty words change nothing.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/why-dolly-hide: Dolly and the others are trapped in the past. We can't let the suffering from our ancestors dictate our future. It's time for a fresh start.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/why-not-wait: What if they're thinking of kicking us out ? What if a scavenger gets into our tunnel again, and a fight start between them and one of my dogs ? We must settle an understanding. The time is now.
junkville/dogs/leader.negociations/why-player: I don't trust ponies. But I've watched you, and you're not like the others who came before. If there's any chance the surface will accept us and respect our limits, you're the closest thing to it.
junkville/dogs/leader.neutral-ground: The tension in his shoulders eases, just slightly. He still doesn't trust you - not really. But for now, he's willing to talk.
junkville/dogs/leader.pass-on-junkville-decision-accept: Yes, the surface dwellers have accepted your terms. They want to speak with you and are expecting your representatives.
junkville/dogs/leader.pass-on-junkville-decision-reject: Yes. I'm afraid the surface dwellers do not want anything to do with you.
junkville/dogs/leader.proposal-intro-back: Let's talk about something else first.
junkville/dogs/leader.proposal-intro-confirm: I mean it. I'll clear them out.
junkville/dogs/leader.push-to-hide-dolly: Not the whole pack agrees with you. Dolly doesn't want to trade with the surface, and she's likely not alone. If you force them to work with the surface dwellers, they'll turn on you.
junkville/dogs/leader.push-to-hide-further: I've been up there. It's a dangerous place, filled with ponies even more cruel than those who put your ancestors in chains. By building bridges with the surface, you're putting your pack at risk.
junkville/dogs/leader.push-to-hide-wait: They're not ready. Neither are you. You should wait.
junkville/dogs/leader.ransom-entry-healed-dogs: I healed your wounded myself. You no longer need the supplies.
junkville/dogs/leader.ransom-entry-not-yet: Not yet, but I'm working on it.
junkville/dogs/leader.ransom-entry-payup: Here's what you asked for: the medical kit, and the potions.
junkville/dogs/leader.ransom-entry-turncoat: I changed my mind. You won't get anything.
junkville/dogs/leader.reject-scavenger-trade: No, I'm not a mailpony. Take care of this yourselves.
junkville/dogs/leader.release-request-attempt: [Speech] They're not soldiers, they're scavengers - scared, and in over their heads. You gain nothing by keeping them, and a lot by letting them go.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavenger-ask-wounded: Some of the Diamond Dogs have been wounded ? What happened ?
junkville/dogs/leader.scavenger-ask-wounded-post-healed: Now that your dogs are healed, can you tell me what wounded them in the first place?
junkville/dogs/leader.scavenger-ask-wounded-rollback: How did the diamond dogs get hurt in the first place ?
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers-ask-why-captives: Why haven't you released the scavengers yet ?
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/about: The scavengers… yes. Three of them wandered into our tunnels not long ago, poking around where they shouldn't. We've kept them - unharmed, for now. But make no mistake, they are not our guests.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/about-from-wounded: There's a way, actually. Three scavengers wandered into our tunnels not long ago, poking around where they shouldn't. We've been holding onto them ever since. Perhaps that's worth something, to whoever sent them - or to whoever comes looking.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/captives: Panic does strange things to a pony. The moment we cornered them, they turned on each other - one tried to bargain with the others' lives, another begged, the third went for a knife hidden in her boot. I don't trust a word out of any of their mouths. If I sent one back with a message, they'd bolt the second they were out of sight, or twist my words into something they never were. You, though - you walked in here on your own, and you're still standing here talking instead of running. That makes you more useful to me than any of them.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/convince-success:
Hm… you may be right. Very well. Tell the scavengers they are free to go - a token of my good will.
However, you must now pay the kindness back. Go, and bring me the medicine kit and the five healing potions we require.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/intimidation-failure: Here we go… always threats and violence. After all that happened, have poneys really not changed at all ? You can try to force your will on us, but you will not come out of it unscathed.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/intimidation-success: Here we go… always threats and violence. After all that happened, have poneys really not changed at all ? You look like a powerful warrior, and we wouldn't be able to oppose you without losing several of our kind. Very well… you may tell the scavengers they're free to go.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/introduction:
No. Not until you answer my plea. This is not an inn. You came into our territory. You will come out of it with a quest… or not at all.

Scavengers from the surface got into our tunnels, not long ago. We did not kill them. But we did not let them go either. We were waiting for someone to come looking for them. You'll do. You will relay our message to the surface dwellers.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/motives: What we want is simple. We need medical supplies to care for our wounded - a proper kit, and five healing draughts. Bring us that, and I'll have the scavengers released the moment it's delivered.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-dogs-healed:
You did that ?

Maybe we were wrong about the surface dwellers. Very well. Go tell the scavengers they are free to go.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-motives-followup: It's up to you to convince them. If you fail, then they may forget about us, or pick up what they started back before the great disaster, and murder us all… buf if we must fall, then we fall with blood on our fangs and claws.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-not-yet: The clock is ticking, surface dweller. My dogs are in bad shape. And the scavengers… they're feeling the angst. Don't take too long.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-not-yet-freed: I've been trusting your word so far, surface dweller. Don't make me regret it. My dogs are in bad shape. They need your help.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-received:
He inspects the good carefully, and nods with approbation:

This goes to show that ponies can hold true to their words, sometimes. My pack will be able to raise again.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-received-free-scave: You may go and tell the scavengers they're free to go.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-received-scavengers: The scavengers were already free to go. This is where our barter ends, then.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-ransom-turnedcoat:
You betrayed my trust, little pony ? Do you believe I'm going to let this go ?

You die. Right here, right now. We'll hang your body in the junkyard, hopefully whoever comes next will be more careful than you were.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/on-reject-trade:
Oh ? Then you are of no use to us. How about you go join the scavengers in their pen ?
We'll just have to wait for someone else to come look for them… or you. How do you like that ? Or perhaps you wish to antagonize us further, and I might just kill you right where you stand.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/ransom-entry: You're back. So ? Did the ponys decide to do the right thing ?
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/release-refused: Not good enough. Words are cheap, and I've heard plenty from ponies before. Come back when you've got something better than talk - or bring me what I actually asked for.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/release-request: You want me to just... let them walk? Convince me they're not a threat, that they won't come back with friends and torches, and maybe - maybe - I'll reconsider.
junkville/dogs/leader.scavengers/wounded-intro: Several of my dogs are wounded, badly. We need medicine - a proper kit, healing draughts, more than we can scrounge down here. Without help from the surface, I fear some of them won't make it.
junkville/dogs/leader.spinel/done:
Alright. You've been good to us.

You see Fido heading towards a very well hidden chest, slightly deeper in the cavern. He looks into it, picks something up, and comes back to you.

Take the spinel. You've earned it.
junkville/dogs/leader.spinel/entry:
Spinels charged with some kind of thunder spell, yes. Ponies used to make those out of the minerals we extracted from these tunnels.

We still have one sitting around. We have no use for it.
junkville/dogs/leader.spinel/not-liked-enough: But it seems like this spinel has value to you. Prove yourself to us, make yourself useful, and maybe I'll consider giving it to you.
junkville/dogs/leader.start-fight: Not if I kill you first !
junkville/dogs/leader.why-here-following-trail: I'm following the trail of some missing ponies.
junkville/dogs/leader.why-here-traveler: I'm a wasteland traveler, nothing more.
junkville/dogs/leader.wounded-intro-tell-me-more: Is there anything I can do?
